clips.title: The story
paras: A quiet message draws a young gnome warlock toward the shadows of Anvilmar. Sten Stoutarm passes it along, and Alamar Grimm calls the neophyte to learn dark power and rely on it rather than their dwarven hosts.

In Coldridge Valley, the dark arts meet deep suspicion. While you help Sten Stoutarm deal with local threats, he slips you a note. His reluctance shows the uneasy truce that lets warlocks practice in Alliance lands. He warns you to watch yourself because your kind is not trusted around these parts.

Inside Anvilmar, Alamar Grimm speaks plainly about the gnomes' plight. He believes conventional tinkering and ordinary magic failed Gnomeregan, bringing their people near extinction and leaving them as second-class refugees dependent on dwarven goodwill. He urges you to rely neither on the Holy Light nor on dwarven politics. Instead, he teaches you to summon and master fiends, whose obedience is unconditional.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the adventurer trainer Alamar. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
And watch yerself, friend, your kind ain't too trusted 'round these parts.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Wonderful! You got my memorandum obviously.

Ignore the fools around you, friend. The Holy Light?! The sword and shield?! These aren't paths for ones as open minded as us. Look at what "normal" magic did to our home. Coupled with those damned tinkerers, our race almost became extinct. And now we have to rely on the dwarves-- they'd rather spend time allying with humans than help us rebuild our own home. We're like second-class citizens. Have you seen the way they look at us?

clips.title: Completion
paras: But none of that matters. What matters is that you've seen your own Holy Light! You know where power truly comes from. You realize that having our own allies is much more... Prudent. Special allies. Allies that, no matter the task, will obey till their last breath.
And that's where I come in, friend. I can train you in the beginnings of those special powers. Seek me out often and I will do what I can to teach you more spells.
